# Final young team hero — built-in image generation

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial workplace photograph for an Argentine and Latin American software company's homepage hero. Landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: four FICTIONAL young Argentine / Latin American colleagues, clearly FOUR DIFFERENT INDIVIDUALS, working with notebooks in a bright contemporary office. The scene should feel like a small technology studio in Buenos Aires. These are illustrative people, not an actual company team.
Cast with deliberately different visible traits (do not duplicate any face or hairstyle):
A — foreground center-right: woman aged about 27, light warm skin with subtle freckles, shoulder-length loose light-brown/auburn curls, a relaxed ivory linen shirt, looking at her silver notebook while using the trackpad.
B — foreground far-right: man aged about 29, fair skin, short straight chestnut hair with a simple side part, CLEAN SHAVEN, a pale muted teal casual shirt with rolled sleeves; sitting beside A, attentively discussing the work, looking at the laptop. His face, jaw and hairstyle must differ strongly from the background man.
C — background middle: woman aged about 25, medium olive skin, straight dark hair in a chin-length bob, thin dark glasses, wearing a charcoal grey T-shirt. Working on her own notebook across the communal table, focused downward.
D — background middle-right, separate from C: man aged about 28, light tan skin, very short buzz-cut hair, a short neat beard, wearing a navy crew-neck T-shirt. Working independently on a graphite notebook at a slightly different angle. Clearly different facial proportions from B.
Composition: candid medium-wide view across a shared light wood worktable. Subjects and laptops are on the RIGHT 55 percent; the LEFT 45 percent is quiet bright office space, softly defocused, for a headline added later in HTML. The two foreground colleagues are the primary subject; two distinct background colleagues add an unmistakable team context. Enough space between people to separate bodies, arms and laptops naturally. Natural scale and depth; background people appear smaller. Show each person only ONCE. Do not mirror, clone, repeat, fuse or reuse faces or bodies.
Setting: simple attractive office with large daylight windows, blurred glass partitions and a little greenery. Contemporary Argentine technology studio feeling, casual clothing, functional worktables, no luxury boardroom. A couple of simple mugs and one closed notebook, minimal clutter.
Style: authentic editorial business photography, natural skin texture and subtle imperfections, realistic hair, hands and anatomy, neutral natural daylight, relaxed focused expressions. Not a posed team photo, not exaggerated smiles. Muted ivory, navy, sage/teal and wood palette. Moderate depth of field: foreground faces and notebooks sharp, background colleagues a little softer but distinct.
Constraints: completely unbranded laptop backs facing the camera; no readable screens, code, UI, logos, words, stickers, watermarks or company signage. No graphic overlays or artificial color glow. No suits, handshakes, crossed arms, stereotypical cultural props or flags. No added white gradient: the website will add its own fade. Do not render a webpage. Only the photograph.
